messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident 1768884123 opened: production p99 latency spike affecting streaming responses (multi-tenant). Paging oncall: @maya_oncall.

maya_oncall: I see alerts — p95 ~ 320ms (normal 120ms), p99 ~ 2.8s, streaming tail stalls at 5–10s. Customers reporting timeouts. Investigating.

kevin_r: Noted — spike started ~ 06:12 UTC. Any recent deploys to preproc or tokenizer?

infra-bot: deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T06:08Z by kevin_r to service/preproc v2.14 rolled to 40% canary.

omar_sre: Can we confirm which routes are hot? Getting per-route SLO breakdown now.

ada_ml: Early signal: tokenization CPU for JSON-mode requests up 6x for some routes where tool schema expansion runs. Tool schema hydration appears to serialize prompt templates + tool schema -> huge string concat.

jess_prod: Customer impacts: 3 enterprise tenants hitting streaming stalls and retries, a few reported partial responses. Escalating to account team.

maya_oncall: Mitigation proposal 1) rollback canary to 0% (kevin) 2) temporarily disable JSON-mode for routes with streaming flag set (ada) 3) add additional preproc workers for tokenizer pool (infra). Which can we do fast?

kevin_r: I can rollback the canary now: `deploy rollback service/preproc 2026-03-15T06:08Z --to stable`

omar_sre: I'm going to increase tokenizer pool from 20 -> 40 on prod pool-a: `kubectl scale deployment/tokenizer --replicas=40 -n prod` and monitor.

ada_ml: To disable JSON-mode per-route quickly we can flip a config in routing: `redeploy-config route/streaming:disable_json_mode=true` — it's dynamic and should take effect in ~30s without full deploy. Recommend doing that for the three affected routes.

kevin_r: Rolling back canary now. will post status.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollback started (2026-03-15T06:19Z).

kevin_r: Rollback complete, canary at 0%.

ada_ml: Flipping disable_json_mode on routes r-enterprise-a, r-enterprise-b, r-sdk-heavy now.

jess_prod: Noted, notifying CS to tell customers we're actively mitigating and will follow up.

omar_sre: Scale command issued, tokenizer replicas -> 40. Watching backlog and CPU.

maya_oncall: Observability update: p99 down from 2.8s -> 1.1s after rollback + config flip. Streaming stalls reduced, tail latency still elevated but improving.

ada_ml: Root cause hypothesis: recent preproc change made tool-schema hydration eager for JSON-mode which forces full tool schema expansion into prompt at hydration time. For long tool schemas this increases tokenization work and blocks streaming path because we normalize/validate JSON first. Combined with canary deploy that changed a concurrency setting, this amplified queueing.

kevin_r: Which PR caused eager hydration? I have a candidate: `git@repo:redwood/preproc#842` — adds eager schema concat for JSON-mode.

maya_oncall: Short-term mitigations done. Next actions: a) revert PR 842 or patch to lazy-hydrate, b) add circuit-breaker to skip schema expansion on streaming short-timeout routes, c) add per-route tokenization metrics + synthetic to catch regressions. Assign.

ada_ml: I'll open a patch to lazy-hydrate and a test harness for tool schemas. Assign to ada_ml.

kevin_r: I'll follow up on PR revert/patch and coordinate with release lead; assign to kevin_r.

omar_sre: I'll instrument per-route tokenization queue length and add alert threshold at 100ms blocking. assign to omar_sre.

jess_prod: I'll coordinate customer comms, CC product and success.

lina_product: Need to track impact on SLAs for those tenants and consider a credit if we fail p99 for more than 30m. I'll start a post-incident report doc.

maya_oncall: Oncall handoff: I need to go offline in ~25m. @omar_sre please take primary until we close.

omar_sre: Taking over. Will keep watches and confirm fixes in canary before closing.

incident-bot: Incident severity updated to sev2 (customer-facing SLO breach).

maya_oncall: Thanks team — quick notes: avoid toggling other preproc flags during mitigation, keep us to rollback+config+scale path. If anything regresses ping pager again.

omar_sre: Observability: p99 steady at ~950ms, streaming stall count down 85% vs peak. Keeping the config change active while patch lands.

kevin_r: PR842 revert created: `PR #847` — small patch to make schema hydration lazy for streaming. Requesting review from ada_ml.

ada_ml: Reviewing now. If tests pass we can ship to canary in ~30m.

jess_prod: CS notified impacted customers at 06:42 UTC. Logging customer responses.

omar_sre: Will run a few synthetic streams against affected routes to validate tail latency. Next update in 20m.

lina_product: Starting incident timeline and customer impact summary for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident 1768884123 updated: last_state_change=2026-03-15T07:02Z, severity=sev2.

omar_sre: 20m check-in: metrics stable, no new regression. Keeping incident open pending PR deploy and monitoring 2h.

maya_oncall: Thanks all — handing off fully to omar. I'll post a short blameless note in postmortem when available.

omar_sre: Acknowledged. Closing the pager rotation now.

(End of thread)
